question.text: A PMS with AUM of Rs. 1,200 cr in equity, equity-related instruments, and mutual fund units must, per SEBI norms, have an automated system with minimal manual intervention for:

answer.text: Order management, allocation, audit trail, and time stamping

explanation.text: The Logic: Once discretionary and non-discretionary AUM in equity, equity-related instruments, and mutual fund units reaches INR 1,000 crore, the portfolio manager must have an automated system with minimal manual intervention for order management, allocation, audit trail, and time stamping. The Trap: Factsheets, weekly external audits, and auto-dialers are not part of the cited INR 1,000 crore automation requirement. Note: The scope here is equity, equity-related instruments, and mutual fund units, as introduced on the cited source page.
